title: Woman Pays the Price After Intentionally Smashing into Police Car
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On April 10, 2023, officers pulled over a female driver who had violated her probation rules in Portage, WI. As the interaction unfolded, her behavior escalated. She refused to leave her vehicle when asked and intentionally reversed, ramming into the police car. Following a pursuit covering several miles with multiple agencies, she eventually pulled over and surrendered herself.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
